column3: “By the hand of” is rendered “by,” and “the great priest” “the high priest.”
“Not a time to come, the time” is rendered “The time has not come, even the time.”
“Set your heart on your ways” is rendered “Consider your ways!”
“Brought” is rendered “harvest”; the perfects are rendered with present forms, and “not to be warm to him” is rendered “no one is warm enough.”
“Set your heart on your ways” is rendered “Consider your ways!”
“Hill country” is rendered “mountains,” and “house” “temple”; “take pleasure” is rendered “be pleased.”
“You turned to look to much” is rendered “You look for much”; “blew on it” is rendered “I blow it away,” and NASB adds “home.”
“On you” is rendered “because of you,” and “heavens” “sky.”
“Listened to the voice” is rendered “obeyed the voice,” and “were afraid of the face of” “showed reverence for.”
